evidence.deltaCalculation: 20% discount applied for 7 months past contract expiry (2026-01-15). Monthly loss: $833.33, Cumulative: $5833.33

Wave 2 (System Cross-Examination): Examined active billing records. The billing system still applies a 20% discount on the recurring invoice.
Wave 3 (Drift Causality Diagnosis): RevOps / Sales configured the promotional discount as an indefinite recurring coupon rather than an auto-expiring 6-month rule.
Wave 4 (Valuation & True-up Formulation): Compounding for 7 months results in $5833.33 total under-billed ARR ($833.33/mo).
agenticReasoning.contractAnalysis: Section 3.2 specifies: "- Discount: 20% for first 6 months". The discount was strictly temporary for onboarding (first 6 months) and has legally lapsed.
agenticReasoning.driftDiagnosis: Billing system coupon failed to expire on 2026-01-15. Recurring invoices continued at discounted rate without automated RevOps notification.
nuanceFlags: No contract amendment or VP override found extending the discount window.
Under-billing is fully contractual and recoverable via retroactive true-up.
agenticReasoning.recommendedAction: Draft customer true-up invoice for $5833.33 and update billing subscription to full $50,000/yr rate immediately.
